ranked.headline: Benchmarking and new frameworks for single-cell and multi-omics biomarker analysis
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks report low overlap among scRNA-seq feature selectors, while new tools extend multi-omics biomarker and survival modeling.

ranked.headline: Network models of brain dynamics are judged against empirical neural recordings
ranked.summary: Fresh whole-brain and neural mass models are being confronted with HCP, mouse spike and EEG data to test network-level accounts.

ranked.headline: Algorithms resolving haplotypes, repeats, and variants from sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce scalable algorithms that convert raw reads into haplotype, repeat, and variant estimates.

ranked.headline: Computational models reconstruct cell-cycle and tumor-immune population dynamics
ranked.summary: Physics-informed and mechanistic models now link single-cell and spatial data to proliferation, cell-cycle and treatment dynamics across tissues.

ranked.headline: Structured biological inputs in transformer and LLM models for perturbation and design
ranked.summary: Perturbation prediction and molecular design are moving toward models that encode structured biological context as tokens, graphs, or LLM reasoning.

ranked.headline: Spatial omics frameworks tackle alignment, phenotyping, and cross-platform integration
ranked.summary: Spatially resolved tumor profiles across imaging platforms demand standardized QC, alignment, and benchmarking before biological interpretation.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned models span protein design, docking, and function prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications combine 3D structure, surface, and language-model embeddings to improve protein design and prediction across tasks.

ranked.headline: Latent models reconcile unpaired, sparse, and spatial single-cell modalities
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair disentangled and foundation-model representations with unpaired, sparse, and spatial single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Compiled and GPU kernels speed up sequencing read, network and coverage-track processing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers report faster scRNA-seq, duplicate-marking and regulatory-network tools built on compiled, multithreaded or GPU implementations.

ranked.headline: Simulation mechanisms and free-energy workflows inform ligand optimization
ranked.summary: Automated free-energy workflows and trajectory-level analyses are now applied across distinct receptor, disordered-protein, and antibody targets.

ranked.headline: Pretrained embeddings and new benchmarks reshape deep learning for molecular prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein and chemical embeddings now drive kinetic, docking, and potential prediction, with evaluation designs exposing generalization limits.

ranked.headline: Scalable genomic tools for k-mer hashing, interval operations and viral element discovery
ranked.summary: Growing genomic datasets demand infrastructure whose scaling or correctness is stated explicitly and paired with open implementations.

ranked.headline: Compositional and robust models recover protein-level information from mixed data
ranked.summary: Proteomic and sequencing measurements that are mixed, zero-inflated, or compositionally constrained need models that respect their structure.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic and data-driven models predict bioprocess, microbial and plant phenotypes
ranked.summary: Sparse, infrequent measurements in bioprocesses and multi-omics studies motivate models that transfer or constrain prediction under data scarcity.

ranked.headline: Interoperable software frameworks are standardizing omics and flux analysis workflows
ranked.summary: Recent releases couple stable-isotope flux, glycan nomenclature, and microbiome analysis into interoperable, end-to-end computational tools.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked method choices guide protein flexibility, stability and library analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications report explicit parameter and metric benchmarks across clustering, gene cluster similarity, flexibility, and ddG prediction.

ranked.headline: Generative and interpretability methods for genomic and protein deep learning models
ranked.summary: Genomic deep learning is now being audited for confounders, leakage, and missingness, alongside generative data synthesis for training and privacy.

ranked.headline: Graph-based models infer drug, microbe and miRNA associations from heterogeneous data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair graph transformers and random walks on heterogeneous networks with explicit handling of unseen entities.

ranked.headline: Reference-anchored workflows for metagenomic taxonomy and amplicon analysis
ranked.summary: Reproducible one-line and Galaxy-hosted pipelines are now paired with explicit reference criteria for taxonomic and amplicon analysis.

ranked.headline: Deep learning links tumor omics and imaging to mutations, survival, and therapy response
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply graph-based and contrastive deep models to multi-omics and histology data for cancer endpoints.

ranked.headline: Generative and energy-based models scaffold enzyme sites into de novo proteins
ranked.summary: Recent enzyme-scaffolding methods, Riff-Diff and RFdiffusion2, place catalytic motifs into de novo proteins with near-native or benchmark-level success.

ranked.headline: Latent-factor methods for multi-omics grouping, biomarker panels and target nomination
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply tensor, web-based and ML feature-selection methods to integrate multi-omic data for biomarker and target discovery.

ranked.headline: Microbial community models: identifiability limits and Lotka-Volterra coupling errors
ranked.summary: Recent work tests identifiability and Lotka-Volterra accuracy in microbial community models, where coupling strength and timescale separation drive error.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and adapting omics methods for structural variants, editing, and long reads
ranked.summary: Long-read and short-read datasets now reveal calling errors, annotation bias, and screen confounders that require explicit benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Local lipid, ligand and glycan environments reshape protein energy landscapes
ranked.summary: Multi-microsecond MD, metadynamics and steered pulling now resolve how membranes, ligands and glycans shift protein conformational energetics.

ranked.headline: Latent and manifold models recast neuroimaging as low-dimensional brain structure
ranked.summary: Latent-space and manifold methods are now applied to brain-behavior linking, dynamic brain data, and longitudinal disease forecasting.

ranked.headline: Methods sharpen calibration of genetic association discovery and fine-mapping
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend association and fine-mapping models to regulatory annotation, variant missingness and multitrait structure.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict TCR-pMHC and MHC-peptide binding across benchmark designs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark TCR, MHC and antibody binding predictors, emphasizing negative-set design and feature representation.

ranked.headline: Generative models sample protein conformations, energies, and transition pathways
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether generative and Bayesian samplers reproduce physical quantities such as energies, populations, and transition paths.

ranked.headline: Constrained optimization for marker selection, deconvolution and cell identity
ranked.summary: Explicit objective formulations now drive cell identity, marker, and composition inference from single-cell, spatial, and bulk data.

ranked.headline: Tunable control of gene circuit patterns, perceptrons, and protein neural networks
ranked.summary: Genetic circuits are being specified with explicit tuning handles for pattern onset, threshold behavior, and resource-coupled weights.

ranked.headline: Modelling selection on weakly deleterious mutations across genomes and viruses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study quantify linkage, biophysical stability and weakly deleterious selection within explicit mutation-scale models.

ranked.headline: Single-cell tracking is now converted into lineage atlases and model inputs
ranked.summary: Time-lapse imaging now yields quantitative phenotypic profiles and lineage atlases, not only tracks, across recent preprints and a published study.

ranked.headline: Reduced stochastic models connect cell-level noise to population and kinetic behavior
ranked.summary: Three preprints tie single-cell detection, growth noise and chromatin states to explicit kinetic models tested against data.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks map cell states, ion channels and regulatory networks
ranked.summary: Multi-source transcriptomic and interaction-network data are now being mined computationally to resolve cell-state, channel and regulatory architecture.

ranked.headline: Telomere-to-telomere assemblies and language models refine genome annotation resolution
ranked.summary: Complete reference genomes and sequence language models now constrain which annotated variants and genomic features can be interpreted reliably.

ranked.headline: Motifs and duplication shape human replication origins and regulatory elements
ranked.summary: Genome-scale sequence analyses now map replication origins, duplicated regulatory elements, and duplication-derived miRNA pairs across genomes.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics and long-read genomics map regulatory genes, triplexes, and disease loci
ranked.summary: Integrating long-read genomes, eQTL-microbiome mapping, and LLM-assisted curation sharpens prediction of regulatory gene targets.

ranked.headline: Computational scoring of proteoform, spectral variant, and fold-switch states
ranked.summary: Proteome-scale catalogs and spectral libraries now enable systematic computational scoring of protein and molecular variant states beyond canonical annotation.

ranked.headline: Stochastic simulation and inference of local rules driving population-level dynamics
ranked.summary: Simulation and inference tools for stochastic reaction networks and DNA methylation models now expose how microscopic rules shape population outcomes.
